steps.instruction: Melt 1 cup of butter in a large pot over medium heat.
Add 2 cups of semolina and stir for 10 minutes.
steps.spoken: Add 2 cups of semolina and stir all the time for about 10 minutes, until it turns golden brown and smells nutty.

steps.instruction: Turn the heat down to low.
Add 1 cup of sugar and 1 teaspoon of ground cardamom, and mix well.
Slowly pour in 1 cup of milk, stirring all the time.
steps.spoken: Slowly pour in 1 cup of milk. Keep stirring so no lumps form.

steps.instruction: Keep cooking and stirring the mixture for 10 minutes.
steps.spoken: Keep cooking and stirring for 10 to 15 minutes, until it thickens and pulls away from the sides of the pot. It should be smooth and creamy.

steps.instruction: Take the pot off the heat and let it cool a little.
Spoon the pudding into bowls or onto a large platter.
Smooth the top with the back of a spoon.
Sprinkle ground cinnamon and chopped nuts on top, if you like.
steps.spoken: If you like, sprinkle ground cinnamon and chopped nuts on top. Serve it warm or at room temperature.
